generation.explanation: The chance you’re sick is about 8.3%, assuming the test detects 90% of sick people and correctly clears 90% of healthy people. Among 10,000 people, 100 are sick, so 90 test positive; of the 9,900 healthy people, 990 also test positive. That makes 90 sick people out of 1,080 positive results: 90 ÷ 1,080 ≈ 8.3%. Drag the prevalence handle to see why the disease’s rarity matters.
